evidence: Thin films of (La,Sr)CoO3−δ were successfully grown in a commercial ALD reactor (F-120, ASM Microchemistry Ltd) using La(thd)3 (thd: 2,2,6,6-tetramethyl-3,5-heptanedione), Sr(thd)2, and Co(acac)3 (acac: acetylacetonate) as metal precursors and ozone as the oxygen source. Nitrogen (99.999%, 300 sccm, Schmidlin UHPN 3000N generator) was used as the carrier and purge gas in the depositions with the background pressure of ca. 2–3 mbar (1.5 –2 Torr).
